name: PatentPortfolioDocket
tagline: Patent docketing for Power Apps: families, office actions, annuities and every PCT deadline in one control.
description: A complete patent docketing app in one PCF code component: docket register, patent families with coverage and national phase countdown, deadline calendar, prosecution board with status rules, office action handling and an annuity planner with Pay / Review / Drop decisions. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Priority year, national phase (30/31 months) and examination request deadlines
US maintenance fees and annual annuities with grace periods
Coverage gaps per family with pre-filled national phase filings
Drag-and-drop prosecution board with validated transitions
Office action response, extension and allowance fee actions
Annuity budget by quarter with decisions, payment and lapse
Bulk actions, CSV export and undo
Phone layout with cards, agenda and bottom navigation
